verdict.root_cause_reason: The report identifies the backfill-carrier-events job on tracking-db as the origin and explains the same mechanism as the key: heavy write load and lock contention drove tracking-db latency up, held tracking-api connections longer, and exhausted the pool. It also treats the later pool-size cut as an amplifier, not the primary cause.
unsupported_claims: "pool wait p99 rose to about 1,950 ms"
